candidates.change_summary: Replace 'balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;' with 'balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;', so deposits overwrite rather than accumulate, making balances[k] differ for any k after multiple deposits.

Replace 'balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;' with 'balances[tx.origin] += msg.value;', crediting the transaction origin instead of the caller, which differs when Deposit is invoked through an intermediary contract.

Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' with 'balances[msg.sender]-= msg.value;', decrementing the caller's balance on deposit, so balances[k] differs whenever the caller already had a nonzero balance.
Delete the assignment MinSum = _val so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Replace MinSum = _val with MinSum = _val + 1 so MinSum is set to a different value.
Replace require(!intitalized) with require(intitalized) so the function reverts before initialization and no longer sets MinSum in that state.
Remove the require(!intitalized) guard so SetMinSum can also update MinSum after initialization.
Invert the require guard so SetMinSum only updates MinSum after the contract has been initialized.
Store _val incremented by one instead of _val, so MinSum always differs by 1 after a successful call.
Remove the require(!intitalized) guard so SetLogFile can overwrite Log even after initialization.
Remove the assignment Log = LogFile(_log) so Log stays address(0) after SetLogFile.
Invert the guard to require(intitalized) so SetLogFile only succeeds after initialization.
Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment so each deposit overwrites rather than adds to the caller's balance.
Delete the balance update statement so deposits only emit a log message and never change the caller's balance.
Delete the Log.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the LogFile history.
Change the require overflow-guard comparison from >= to > so a zero-value deposit now reverts.
